highlights: Budget vs actual has its own sidebar report, with six-month trends, category comparisons, unbudgeted spending and transaction drill-downs.
Compact green/red budget bars use a fixed 150% scale, a 100% marker, percentage labels and subtle column separators.
Set one-month budgets or repeat them for a chosen number of months, then override individual months and restore the original plan.
Recurring bills consume their category's budget allowance in forecasts and reports, keeping actual spending and upcoming commitments clear without counting the allowance twice.
Custom date and month pickers, an Overview month filter and aligned chart controls make planning easier on desktop and mobile.
Overview now combines six months of recorded balances with three months of dotted projections, spending trends, category summaries and attention shortcuts.
A clearer Expenses layout puts charts and breakdowns side by side, simplifies legends and gives transactions more room for inline category and type changes.
Compact filter bars support multiple choices, anchored date-range panels and saved filters, pagination and Back position.
Smaller account cards use distinct owner bubbles; matching saved rules replace the Remember action so their status and controls stay together.
Assign unique colours to all categories at once, with an Undo option and protection against overwriting newer edits.
Cleaner planning, inline budget editing, grouped assets and debts, valuation explanations and net-worth date ranges.
Import review status filters and reachable action bars, clearer save/retry feedback, aligned Graph/Table controls and mobile layout improvements.
Correct missing years and individual PDF dates directly in statement review.
Categorise transactions in Expenses, drill-downs, recent activity and transaction details; remember matches within Expense filters.
Transfer money to assets and liabilities with automatic value updates and recorded movement history.
Persistent error feedback, corrective controls and safe refresh actions across the app.
Mobile layout improvements and this release history.
